title: WinUI Runtime DevTools Protocol
summary: Canonical, CDP-shaped source of truth for the WinUI design-time engine. Hand-authored (DAP-style); the CLI command-graph and docs facades are generated from this file. Grounded in the proven substrate: the proven transport (newline JSON-RPC 2.0 + server notifications) is the envelope; the proof-of-concept's live ops (findname/children/getchild/setprop/census) are the first VisualTree/Property/Source methods.

framing.reference: See envelope.md for the normative framing spec.

errorCodes.name: InvalidRequest
errorCodes.summary: The JSON sent is not a valid Request object.

errorCodes.name: MethodNotFound
errorCodes.summary: The method does not exist / is not available.

errorCodes.name: TargetLost
errorCodes.summary: The attached app exited or its dispatcher is gone. Re-attach.

errorCodes.name: StaleHandle
errorCodes.summary: Node handle generation mismatch. Re-enumerate to refresh handles.

errorCodes.name: NotOnDispatcher
errorCodes.summary: A mutation was routed off the UI DispatcherQueue (RPC_E_WRONG_THREAD analog). The engine must marshal; clients should never see this.

errorCodes.name: CapabilityUnsupported
errorCodes.summary: The requested capability/version was not negotiated. Negotiation returns this cleanly; never crash.

errorCodes.name: Unauthorized
errorCodes.summary: The session lacks a grant for this command family or the token expired.

errorCodes.name: RefusedUnsafe
errorCodes.summary: The engine classified the edit as unsafe to apply in place and refused rather than risk corruption.

errorCodes.name: UnreachableGate
errorCodes.summary: A required apply gate (e.g. render verification) could not be reached.

errorCodes.name: SourceUnavailable
errorCodes.summary: No source provenance for this element (runtime-only, or spans stripped). Not an error condition to fear — use the anchor.

errorCodes.name: Cancelled
errorCodes.summary: The request was cancelled via WDXP.cancel.

types.summary: Grades any best-effort resolution (source spans, identity, diagnostics). Ordered strongest→weakest.

The four-outcome classifier a transactional apply/commit reports (HotReload.commit/apply; predicted in a plan's classification). Honesty invariant: never report a stronger outcome than actually achieved. An ephemeral Property.set returns the resulting PropertyValue, not an Outcome.
Command risk tier. Drives consent, audit, and grant policy (Security domain). Every command declares one.

riskTiers.summary: No app-visible mutation: enumerations, reads, subscriptions, resolution.
Live runtime override that is NOT persisted (a set-property preview).
Adds/removes/moves live elements or commits a runtime transaction.
Writes back to source on disk.

domains.summary: Protocol built-ins present on every session before any capability is negotiated.

types.summary: A negotiable capability and the version the peer offers.

commands.name: negotiate
commands.summary: Exchange supported capabilities/versions. Session = connection; call this first. Unknown capabilities return CapabilityUnsupported, never a crash.

parameters.name: capabilities
parameters.summary: Capabilities the client wants, with the max version it understands.

returns.name: agreed
returns.summary: The intersection the engine will honor for this session.

commands.name: cancel
commands.summary: Request cancellation of an in-flight request by its JSON-RPC id. Best-effort; long reads and applies honor it at safe points.

parameters.name: id
parameters.summary: The JSON-RPC id (a string — WDXP pins string ids protocol-wide, envelope §2) of the request to cancel.

returns.name: cancelled
returns.summary: True if a matching in-flight request was found and signaled.

events.name: sessionClosing
events.summary: The engine is tearing the session down (target lost or shutdown). Clients should stop issuing commands.

domains.summary: Discover, attach to, and track the lifecycle of a running WinUI app (target). Session = connection; attach binds this connection to one target.

types.summary: Opaque, stable-for-process target id.
Packaged vs unpackaged identity of a target.
The UI thread / DispatcherQueue all mutations MUST marshal to (threading contract). Reads may run off-thread; mutations may not.

properties.name: threadId
properties.summary: OS thread id of the UI thread.

properties.name: queueId
properties.summary: Opaque DispatcherQueue id when multiple roots exist.

types.summary: A discovered or attached target.

properties.name: protocolVersion
properties.summary: wdxp version the in-app engine speaks.

types.summary: Why a target went away.

commands.name: list
commands.summary: Enumerate attachable WinUI targets on this machine for the current user.

commands.name: attach
commands.summary: Bind this connection to a target and negotiate capabilities against it. Loud-fail before an unsafe attach: version mismatch or a missing required runtime component returns an error, never a partial attach.

parameters.name: requiredCapabilities
parameters.summary: Capabilities the client cannot proceed without; attach fails loudly if unavailable.

returns.name: granted
returns.summary: Capability families granted for this session.

commands.name: detach
commands.summary: Release the target without closing the app.

commands.name: reconnect
commands.summary: Re-bind after a transport blip; preserves session identity if the target still lives.

events.name: targetLost
events.summary: The attached target went away; the session is dead.

domains.summary: The guaranteed read floor: enumerate/search/subscribe the live XAML visual tree. Config-independent and proven (maps to TAP findname/children/getchild). This is 'XAML sight day one.'

types.summary: A live element reference. The generation guards against stale handles across tree mutations.

properties.name: handle
properties.summary: Opaque element handle: a uint64 encoded as a decimal string so precision is never lost as a JSON number (envelope §2). Treat as opaque — never do arithmetic on it.

properties.name: generation
properties.summary: Increments when the handle is invalidated; a mismatch yields StaleHandle.

types.summary: Honest incompleteness (REQ-A1): why an enumeration cannot fully see a subtree. Reported, never silently dropped.
One node in the visual tree.

properties.name: incompleteness
properties.summary: Present when this node's children are known to be partial.

commands.name: enumerate
commands.summary: Enumerate the tree from a node (or the roots) to a depth. Honest incompleteness is reported per node.

parameters.name: node
parameters.summary: Start node; omit for all roots.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.summary: Max depth; omit for full subtree.

commands.name: search
commands.summary: Find live elements by x:Name across all roots (maps to TAP findname/findalltype).

commands.name: describe
commands.summary: Describe a single node.

commands.name: subscribe
commands.summary: Subscribe to structural changes under a node (or all roots).

commands.name: unsubscribe
commands.summary: Cancel a subscription.

events.name: childrenChanged
events.summary: Children of a subscribed node were added/removed. Handles carry the new generation.

domains.summary: Read and (ephemerally) override dependency properties. value-source precedence is first-class: a set without knowing the current source is an agent foot-gun.

types.summary: DP value-source precedence, highest→lowest. Reports where the current value actually comes from.
Static shape of a dependency property.
A property's live value plus provenance.

commands.name: get
commands.summary: Get properties of a node, each tagged with its value-source (maps to TAP getprop/inspect).

parameters.name: names
parameters.summary: Specific properties; omit for the common set.

commands.name: describe
commands.summary: Describe a property (owner/type/writeability) before setting it.

commands.name: set
commands.summary: Set a property live as an ephemeral runtime override (maps to TAP setprop/seth). Runs on the UI dispatcher.

commands.name: setPreview
commands.summary: Set a transient preview value that auto-reverts (for scrubbing). Never persisted.

domains.summary: Resolve and read XAML resources with provenance (StaticResource vs ThemeResource vs system).

types.summary: StaticResource (snapshot) vs ThemeResource (theme-tracking) vs system-provided.
A resolved resource.

commands.name: resolve
commands.summary: Resolve a resource key in the context of a node (respects merged dictionaries and theme).

commands.name: read
commands.summary: Read a resource from the app/system scope without a node context.

domains.summary: Confidence-graded provenance over the read floor (RT1). NEVER the load-bearing wedge: a guaranteed tree+name+file floor with a never-wrong best-effort line layer. The census proved file-level provenance is durable across Debug/Release/DisableXbfLineInfo; line precision is gated on that one switch.

types.summary: Provenance class. source-backed REQUIRES confidence exact|high with a span (false-confident prohibition).
A location in authored markup. uri is an ms-appx:/// or ms-resource:/// URI, not a filesystem path.

properties.name: line
properties.summary: 1-based line; absent/0 when line info is stripped.

properties.name: lineInfo
properties.summary: False when DisableXbfLineInfo stripped spans; the uri still survives.

types.summary: Stable non-source anchor used when spans are stripped or absent.

properties.name: treePath
properties.summary: Structural path from a root (e.g. type+child-index chain).

types.summary: The confidence-graded answer for one element.

properties.name: span
properties.summary: The declaration span when confidently known.

properties.name: realizedIndex
properties.summary: Index of a realized virtualized item.

properties.name: itemKey
properties.summary: Data item key for a realized template instance.

commands.name: resolve
commands.summary: Resolve an element to source. Obeys the false-confident prohibition: it will down-grade kind/confidence rather than guess a span.

commands.name: anchor
commands.summary: Return only the stable anchor (cheap; always available even with no source).

domains.summary: Structured runtime diagnostics as API, not log text: parser errors, binding failures, apply results, and source-gaps as first-class diagnostics.

types.summary: Machine reason codes. Diagnostics are branched on by agents, so they are typed, not strings.
One diagnostic event payload.

commands.name: subscribe
commands.summary: Subscribe to the diagnostic stream, optionally filtered by reason code.

commands.name: unsubscribe
commands.summary: Cancel a diagnostics subscription.

events.name: diagnostic
events.summary: A parser/binding/apply failure or a source-gap.

domains.summary: Classified edit application with an explicit transaction taxonomy (impl is W5, demand+EDR-gated). plan is a pure read (classify without applying); commit/rollback/apply mutate. The honesty invariant is retained end-to-end.

types.summary: Which pipeline an edit routes to (XAML in-place vs C# EnC).
The lifecycle states an agent branches on. Terminal-failure states (stale-handle/target-lost/refused-unsafe/unreachable-gate) are honest, not exceptions.
A single classified edit.

properties.name: detail
properties.summary: Opaque edit payload (diff/span/value) — shape owned by W5.

types.summary: The result of classifying a set of edits without applying them.

commands.name: plan
commands.summary: Classify edits and return a plan + predicted outcome. Pure read; nothing is applied.

commands.name: preview
commands.summary: Apply a plan as a reversible runtime-only preview.

commands.name: commit
commands.summary: Commit a previewed transaction to the running app.

commands.name: rollback
commands.summary: Roll back a previewed or committed-runtime transaction.

commands.name: apply
commands.summary: One-shot plan+commit(+persist) of a single edit. Returns the honest terminal state and outcome.

events.name: transactionStateChanged
events.summary: A transaction advanced (or failed into) a state.

domains.summary: Element highlight and pick (impl is W6). ALWAYS an out-of-proc transparent click-through overlay window over UIA/visual bounds — NEVER an injected Adorner. Documented fallback to inert bounding-box screenshots when live tracking lags.

types.summary: How the overlay renders the element bounds.

commands.name: highlight
commands.summary: Highlight an element via the out-of-proc overlay.

commands.name: pick
commands.summary: Let the user pick an element on screen; returns the chosen node (reverse of highlight).

commands.name: clear
commands.summary: Clear all overlays.

domains.summary: CORE, not periphery (RT5). Pipe ACL + same-user process auth + per-session nonce/token + replay prevention + capability grants by command family + explicit consent + tamper-resistant local audit + target allowlist + token expiry + command risk tiers. Impl is W8; the contract is normative now.

types.summary: A capability-family grant for the session.
One tamper-resistant local audit record.

commands.name: authenticate
commands.summary: Establish session auth over the same-user pipe and issue a per-session token bound to the resolved host identity. Nonce issuance and replay-prevention policy are host-defined and finalized in W8 (Security).

parameters.name: token
parameters.summary: Prior session token (from a previous authenticate) for reconnect; omit for a fresh handshake.

returns.name: token
returns.summary: Opaque per-session token to present on a later reconnect. Issuance/nonce/replay policy is host-defined, finalized in W8.

returns.name: expiresAt
returns.summary: ISO-8601 token expiry; absent = session lifetime.

commands.name: grant
commands.summary: Grant capability families to the session with explicit consent; higher risk tiers require explicit (not session-default) consent.

commands.name: audit
commands.summary: Read the local audit log (tamper-evident).

events.name: grantChanged
events.summary: A grant was added, revoked, or expired.
